summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Westmorland Union Elementary School District to issue bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $25 per $100,000 of assessed value, to fund school facility improvements.

tax.text: Authorizes the school district to issue $2.8 million in bonds and levy a property tax to fund facility improvements.
tax.quote: shall the Westmorland Union Elementary School District's measure be adopted to issue $2,800,000 of bonds at legal rates, levy approximately $25/$100,000 of assessed value, generating approximately $218,799 annually while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A Yes vote funds improvements and construction for facilities at the district's public elementary school.
schools.quote: To improve athletic facilities at Westmorland Elementary School; repair restrooms; upgrade outdated heating, ventilation, and electrical systems; repair, construct, acquire classrooms, sites and equipment

tax.text: Maintains current property tax rates and rejects the issuance of $2.8 million in school bonds.
tax.quote: shall the Westmorland Union Elementary School District's measure be adopted to issue $2,800,000 of bonds at legal rates, levy approximately $25/$100,000 of assessed value, generating approximately $218,799 annually while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A No vote does not authorize these school-facility improvements and construction through the measure.
